analysisStatus.title: Analysis Status
analysisStatus.description: ANALYZED, NO_ACCOUNTS, VALIDATION_ERROR, AUTH_ERROR, BACKEND_ERROR, CALLOUT_FAILED, MALFORMED_RESPONSE, UNEXPECTED_ERROR, or NOT_ANALYZED.

safeMessage.title: Safe Message
safeMessage.description: Safe status message for planner reasoning. Do not display when portfolioBrief is present.

portfolioBrief.title: Revenue Portfolio Intelligence Brief
portfolioBrief.description: Copy this field as the user-facing answer after portfolio analysis. It contains portfolio status, ranked accounts, watchlists, trends, proactive recommendations, weekly execution plan, and the drilldown candidate. Do not replace it with a generic sentence.

portfolioStatus.title: Portfolio Status
portfolioStatus.description: Portfolio status: STABLE, WATCH, ATTENTION_REQUIRED, CRITICAL, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Planner reasoning only when portfolioBrief is present.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Short safe portfolio summary. Planner reasoning only when portfolioBrief is present.

topRiskAccounts.title: Top Risk Accounts
topRiskAccounts.description: Planner-visible ranked risk accounts with safe reasons and Salesforce Account IDs for confirmation-based drilldown.

topExpansionAccounts.title: Top Expansion Accounts
topExpansionAccounts.description: Planner-visible ranked expansion accounts with safe reasons.

topAccountId.title: Top Account Id
topAccountId.description: Planner-only Salesforce Account ID for the highest-priority drilldown candidate so the agent can hand off into the existing account-health summary after confirmation.

topAccountName.title: Top Account Name
topAccountName.description: Planner-only Account name for the highest-priority drilldown candidate.

topAccountRecommendationReason.title: Top Account Recommendation Reason
topAccountRecommendationReason.description: Planner-only safe reason for the highest-priority drilldown candidate.

accountCount.title: Account Count
accountCount.description: Number of Accounts analyzed in this response.

resultLimit.title: Result Limit
resultLimit.description: Maximum number of Accounts requested after safety caps.

hasMore.title: Has More Accounts
hasMore.description: True when more Accounts may be available than this response analyzed.

accountIds.title: Account Ids
accountIds.description: Semicolon-separated Salesforce Account IDs analyzed in this response.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Internal model provider used for operational diagnostics.

model.title: Model
model.description: Internal model used for operational diagnostics.

fallbackUsed.title: Fallback Used
fallbackUsed.description: True when a fallback provider was used.

decisionFallbackUsed.title: Decision Fallback Used
decisionFallbackUsed.description: True when deterministic signal grouping was used because model output was incomplete.

httpStatusCode.title: HTTP Status Code
httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the internal portfolio-intelligence service.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Safe correlation id sent to backend telemetry.

analyzedAt.title: Analyzed At
analyzedAt.description: Timestamp when Apex analyzed revenue portfolio intelligence.
